If you’re a beginner trader, especially trading prop firm accounts, save this.

One of the biggest mistakes you can make is feeling like you must trade because you have an account.

You don’t.

If you’re busy, stay out of the market. If there’s no clean setup, stay out. If the market isn’t giving you your setup, do absolutely nothing.

Your job isn’t to trade every day.

Your job is to protect your account and wait for the right opportunity.

Patience is not doing nothing. Patience is knowing when NOT to trade.
